title: 第1章 精神力二十的天才第2章 老头子
lines: 第1章精神力二十的“天才”
“子衿快跑！”
白牧野大喊一声，猛地从床上坐起来，张开双眼。
布满血丝的眼睛看上去有些狰狞。
过了一会儿，他的眼神慢慢恢复清明，神色恢复正常，整个人的气质也一下子变得明朗起来。
如同顺着窗帘缝隙照进来的一抹晨光。
令人心情愉悦。
伸手抹了一把头上湿淋淋的冷汗，长出了一口气，继续坐在那里发呆。
又一次噩梦中惊醒。
这个梦他已经连续做了六年。
不同的场景，相同的人，相似的剧情。
这次是在丛林中。
身材瘦弱的短发小女孩，衣衫染血，步履蹒跚，费力地拖着他前行。
丛林幽暗而又森冷。
四周到处都是绿油油的眼睛，在黑暗里注视着他们。
他动不了，喊不出，胸口像是压着一块大石。
如梦魇般难受。
梦很长，让人充满疲惫。
这么多年，无数次在梦里，他一直想要看清楚小女孩的脸，但永远只有一个背影。
梦的唯一主题，便是逃亡。
无休无止的逃亡！
他不知道自己为什么会多年如一日的做这种梦？
也不知道那个叫子衿的小姑娘到底是谁？
跟他是什么关系？
为了弄清楚，他甚至录制过很多次自己睡觉的视频。
可除了出现频率极高的“子衿快跑”四个字是比较清晰的，其他都是些没意义的呓语。
每次问老头子，他总是打着哈哈给岔开。
说那就是一个梦而已，不必当真。
要么就说他做单身狗年头太多，思春了。
明摆着就是在鬼扯，欺负白牧野是个单纯的孩子。
要是思春做的都是这种梦，人类早就失去繁衍动力了。
老头子肯定知道些什么！
白牧野记忆非常好，不说过目不忘，也差不多少。
可是他无论如何都回忆不起半点关于自己十一岁之前的事情。
一片空白，一点印象都没有。
似乎被人动过手脚，清除掉了那部分记忆。
难道我还是个宝宝的时候，就经历过什么了不得的事情？
莫非我的真正身份其实是一个落魄的皇子，有皇位在等着我去继承？
可为什么我没有一个强大的忠仆陪伴在身边？
老头子么？
content_en:
Chapter 1 The "genius" with twenty mental powers
"Zijin, run!"
Bai Muye shouted, sat up from the bed suddenly, and opened his eyes.
The bloodshot eyes looked a little ferocious.
After a while, his eyes slowly returned to clarity, his expression returned to normal, and his whole temperament suddenly became brighter.
Like a ray of morning light shining through the gap in the curtains.
It makes you feel good.
He stretched out his hand to wipe the cold sweat from his head, took a deep breath, and continued to sit there in a daze.
Woke up from another nightmare.
He has had this dream for six consecutive years.
Different scenes, same people, similar plot.
This time it's in the jungle.
The thin little girl with short hair, her clothes stained with blood, staggered, struggling to drag him forward.
The jungle is dark and cold.
There were green eyes everywhere, watching them in the darkness.
He couldn't move or shout, and it felt like there was a big stone pressing on his chest.
It feels like a nightmare.
The dream is very long and exhausting.
Over the years, countless times in his dreams, he had always wanted to see the little girl's face clearly, but there was always only a back view.
The only theme of the dream is escape.
Endless escape!
He didn't know why he kept having this kind of dream for many years?
I don’t know who the little girl named Zijin is?
What's the relationship with him?
To find out, he even recorded himself sleeping multiple times.
But except for the four words "Zi Jin, run fast" that appear very frequently and are relatively clear, the rest are all meaningless gibberish.
Every time I asked the old man, he always said haha ​​and distracted me.
It's just a dream, don't take it seriously.
Or it could be that he has been single for too many years and is in love with his youth.
It was obvious that he was just talking nonsense, bullying Bai Muye for being an innocent child.
If all Sichun had had were dreams like this, humans would have long since lost their drive to reproduce.
The old man must know something!
Bai Muye has a very good memory. He can't forget everything except what he has said.
But he couldn't recall anything about what happened before he was eleven years old.
It was blank, no impression at all.
It seemed like someone had tampered with it and erased that part of the memory.
Did something extraordinary happen to me when I was a baby?
Could it be that my true identity is actually a down-and-out prince with a throne waiting for me to inherit?
But why don't I have a strong and loyal servant by my side?
Old man?
